Dunree documentation

Reverse proxy and web gateway. Published by Foley IT under AGPL-3.0.

What this page is. A plain list of the documents that come with the Dunree source code. It is not a product website.

  • There is no download and no published container image yet. Dunree is built from source: cd src && go build -o dunree. The file README.md in the root of the repository says how to install it on each system.
  • The documents are Markdown files. A git host shows them formatted; a plain web server shows them as text.
  • Some documents link to files outside this folder (README.md, docker/, packaging/, the source code). Those links only work in a copy of the repository.
